description: This source file implements DNS utility functions for Chromium, including handling DoH provider entries, URL template expansion, connection type time delta retrieval, DNS query type conversions, and secure DNS mode string conversion.

classes.name: DohProviderEntry
classes.description: Represents a DoH provider entry with associated properties such as IP addresses, feature flag, hostname, and server configuration.

classes.name: DnsOverHttpsServerConfig
classes.description: Configuration details for a DNS-over-HTTPS server.

classes.name: IPEndPoint
classes.description: Represents an IP endpoint with address and port.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: Provides network change notifications and connection type enumeration.

classes.name: SecureDnsMode
classes.description: Enumeration for different secure DNS modes.

methods.name: GetDohProviderEntriesFromNameservers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of DoH provider entries matching the given DNS server endpoints.

methods.name: GetURLFromTemplateWithoutParameters
methods.description: Expands a URI template into a URL string without parameters.

methods.name: GetTimeDeltaForConnectionTypeFromFieldTrial
methods.description: Retrieves a TimeDelta value for a specific connection type from a field trial configuration.

methods.name: GetTimeDeltaForConnectionTypeFromFieldTrialOrDefault
methods.description: Returns a TimeDelta for a connection type from field trial or a default value.

methods.name: CreateNamePointer
methods.description: Creates a DNS name pointer in wire format from an offset.

methods.name: DnsQueryTypeToQtype
methods.description: Converts a DnsQueryType enum to its corresponding wire protocol type.

methods.name: AddressFamilyToDnsQueryType
methods.description: Converts an AddressFamily enum to a DnsQueryType.

methods.name: GetDohUpgradeServersFromDotHostname
methods.description: Returns DoH server configurations for a given dot hostname if available.

methods.name: GetDohUpgradeServersFromNameservers
methods.description: Returns DoH server configurations based on provided DNS server endpoints.

methods.name: GetDohProviderIdForHistogramFromServerConfig
methods.description: Gets the provider ID string for histogram purposes from a server config.

methods.name: GetDohProviderIdForHistogramFromNameserver
methods.description: Gets the provider ID string for histogram purposes from a nameserver endpoint.

methods.name: SecureDnsModeToString
methods.description: Converts a SecureDnsMode enum value to its string representation.
